title: Camareiro(a)
description:
Venha viver nosso propósito!


Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de \"cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor\".


Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.



· Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;

· Somos empáticos pois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todo instante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por um ambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!


Sobre a oportunidade:


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Limpeza e Higienização de unidades habitacionais ou Áreas públicas;
  • Auxílio a equipe de Governança nas demandas do dia a dia;
  • Realização de relatórios de limpeza;
  • Suporte aos Inspetores de Governança;
  • Seguir padrões de organização e limpeza da marca.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência na função em hotelaria;
  • Experiência com Duvet;


Benefícios:



  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte de acordo com as suas necessidades;
  • WellHub para atividades voltadas para saúde e bem-estar;
  • Uniforme lavado e passado em nossa Lavanderia;
  • Alimentação realizada no hotel;
  • Kit recém-nascido;
  • Convênio com Drogaria Pacheco;
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino Superior, cursos de idioma e Informática;
  • Parceria com restaurantes próximos ao hotel;
  • Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA);
  • 12 noites cortesia por ano em hotéis da Hyatt pelo mundo;
  • Oportunidades de Encarreiramento.


Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos:

  • Atendimento médico e psicológico gratuito no hotel (conforme agendamento)
  • Sessões de Shiatsu gratuitas no hotel (conforme agendamento)
  • Parceria com plataforma Psicologia Viva, com sessões gratuitas
  • Manicure (conforme agendamento)

title: Japanese Business Developer
description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are developing a partner advertising high-load system with a large RPS, convenient and modern interface. We are growing exponentially and successfully implementing new technologies to accelerate this growth and the system as a whole.

Now we look for a Japanese Business Developer to join our Growth Traffic team


Job Responsibilities

Research and Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough market research on Asian markets to identify opportunities for business expansion.
  • Perform competitive research to stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and potential market gaps.

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective affiliates, tracking outreach progress and follow-ups.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  • Regularly report on progress, including research insights, outreach results, and onboarding statuses.
  • Collaborate closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to align affiliate strategies and achieve team goals.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese language is a must
  • Fluency in English
  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.
  • Strong Network: Ability to leverage an existing network of contacts to expedite outreach and sales
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Bilingual DevOps Engineer Remote
description:
DevOps Engineer


Job Description

We are seeking a qualified DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Kubernetes-based systems in our on-premises data center, handling everything from bare metal hardware and networking to database administration and application deployment. You will address the unique challenges of operating a private cloud, including optimizing AI model operations, CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Enterprise Java and Python services. This role involves hands-on operation of production data center racks, ensuring flawless performance and scalability for our AI-based applications.


Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters using Helm diagrams for orchestration and configuration management.

Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Git, Jenkins, and related tools to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes. Manage Postgres and NoSQL databases, including performance tuning, backups, scaling, and security configurations. Manage physical hardware in our data center racks, including provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining servers and network components.

Implement, monitor, and manage enterprise Java and Python applications, ensuring compatibility with our AI models and infrastructure.


Skills

Advanced english level. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems administration, specializing in Kubernetes and container orchestration. Strong command of Helm for Kubernetes application management. Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins for developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Experience administering Postgres databases, including query optimization, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of Enterprise Java and Python programming for application support and scripting. Exceptional mastery of the Linux operating system.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Arquiteto de software
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Arquiteto

Experiência sólida como Arquiteto de Software e/ou Arquiteto Corporativo, atuando no desenho de arquiteturas de sistemas complexos, distribuídos e integrados.


Conhecimento técnico:

• Arquitetura de Software e Arquitetura Corporativa

• Modelagem e documentação de arquitetura utilizando ferramentas especializadas

(ex.: Enterprise Architect, Archi, Lucidchart ou similares)

• Modelagem arquitetural baseada em ArchiMate (camadas de Negócio, Aplicação e Tecnologia)

• Definição de arquiteturas monolíticas, microsserviços e orientadas a eventos

• Integração de sistemas via APIs REST, mensageria e middlewares

• Experiência com múltiplas linguagens e stacks tecnológicas

(ex.: Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, Frontend Web)

• Arquitetura em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

• Atuação colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, produto, infraestrutura e negócios.


Idioma: Inglês técnico intermediário a avançado para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica, arquitetura de sistemas e interação com fornecedores e parceiros.


Certificações:

Desejável certificações relacionadas à Arquitetura de Software e Arquitetura Corporativa, tais como:

  • TOGAF (Foundation ou Certified)
  • ArchiMate
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • Azure Solutions Architect
  • Google Cloud Architect


Formação:

Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software,

Arquitetura Corporativa ou Engenharia de Software.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Doc Sign
description:
Hiring for DocuSign CLM Consultant | Remote | Long Term Contract


Hi,

Please find the below Job Opportunity.

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Length of Assignment : 12 months Contract

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

Time Zone: Primarily EST; may also support BRT (±1 hour)

Language: English required; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Role Overview

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows , including fixes and new implementations
  • Provide global user support , responding to support cases and assisting end users
  • Perform governance activities , including workflow failure analysis and access reviews
  • Collaborate with and provide knowledge sharing among other CLM administrators

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Engenheiro de Integridade de Poços
description:
A Perenco está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade de Poços para integrar o time de Workover .


O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir a integridade e segurança dos poços em todas as fases operacionais , avaliando e monitorando CSBs, analisando testes de pressão e coordenando ações corretivas e preventivas, sempre em conformidade com normas regulatórias e padrões de HSE.


Principais responsabilidades:


• Desenvolver e atualizar procedimentos técnicos conforme ANP, API e NORSOK;

• Avaliar a integridade dos poços interpretando registros de testes de pressão e histórico dos anulares e colunas;

• Planejar e conduzir campanhas de correção de barreiras e liderar tecnicamente a equipe de manutenção;

• Controlar e atualizar CSBs em todas as fases (perfuração, completação, produção e abandono);

• Criar dispensas técnicas e revisar APRs quando necessário;

• Elaborar relatórios técnicos e indicadores de integridade (KPIs);

• Apoiar tratativas e auditorias junto à ANP, incluindo emissão de RFAP, RFCP e NCSB;

• Acompanhar manutenções e inspeções no sistema Protheus , além de controlar estoques e componentes de integridade;

• Calcular MAASP e MAWOP e definir limites operacionais;

• Garantir conformidade regulatória e alinhamento com as políticas de HSE .


Requisitos:


• Formação completa em Engenharia de Petróleo ;

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área de integridade de poços;

• Conhecimento das normas SGIP , NORSOK e experiência em operações de Workover ;

• Inglês técnico e domínio do Pacote Office ;

• Disponibilidade para embarques esporádicos .


Se você é um(a) profissional dinâmico(a), detalhista e comprometido(a) com a segurança operacional, venha fazer parte do nosso time!


*A Perenco NÃO discrimina por motivo de sexo, raça, etnia, origem ou idade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são também destinadas a Pessoas com Deficiências. As contratações da Perenco são baseadas nas necessidades de seu negócio. Se você se encaixa nos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se!

title: Doc Sign
description:
Hiring for DocuSign CLM Consultant | Remote | Long Term Contract


Hi,

Please find the below Job Opportunity.

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Length of Assignment : 12 months Contract

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

Time Zone: Primarily EST; may also support BRT (±1 hour)

Language: English required; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Role Overview

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows , including fixes and new implementations
  • Provide global user support , responding to support cases and assisting end users
  • Perform governance activities , including workflow failure analysis and access reviews
  • Collaborate with and provide knowledge sharing among other CLM administrators

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

Requirements

  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Qualification that can be a plus:

  • Proven track of overachieving KPIs in Business Development or Sales positions.


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.
  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Bilingual DevOps Engineer Remote
description:
DevOps Engineer


Job Description

We are seeking a qualified DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Kubernetes-based systems in our on-premises data center, handling everything from bare metal hardware and networking to database administration and application deployment. You will address the unique challenges of operating a private cloud, including optimizing AI model operations, CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Enterprise Java and Python services. This role involves hands-on operation of production data center racks, ensuring flawless performance and scalability for our AI-based applications.


Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters using Helm diagrams for orchestration and configuration management.

Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Git, Jenkins, and related tools to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes. Manage Postgres and NoSQL databases, including performance tuning, backups, scaling, and security configurations. Manage physical hardware in our data center racks, including provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining servers and network components.

Implement, monitor, and manage enterprise Java and Python applications, ensuring compatibility with our AI models and infrastructure.


Skills

Advanced english level. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems administration, specializing in Kubernetes and container orchestration. Strong command of Helm for Kubernetes application management. Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins for developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Experience administering Postgres databases, including query optimization, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of Enterprise Java and Python programming for application support and scripting. Exceptional mastery of the Linux operating system.

Hiring for DocuSign CLM Consultant | Remote | Long Term Contract


Hi,

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Doc Sign
description:
Hiring for DocuSign CLM Consultant | Remote | Long Term Contract


Hi,

Please find the below Job Opportunity.

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Length of Assignment : 12 months Contract

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

Time Zone: Primarily EST; may also support BRT (±1 hour)

Language: English required; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Role Overview

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain DocuSign CLM workflows , including fixes and new implementations
  • Provide global user support , responding to support cases and assisting end users
  • Perform governance activities , including workflow failure analysis and access reviews
  • Collaborate with and provide knowledge sharing among other CLM administrators

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Arquiteto de software
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Arquiteto

Experiência sólida como Arquiteto de Software e/ou Arquiteto Corporativo, atuando no desenho de arquiteturas de sistemas complexos, distribuídos e integrados.


Conhecimento técnico:

• Arquitetura de Software e Arquitetura Corporativa

• Modelagem e documentação de arquitetura utilizando ferramentas especializadas

(ex.: Enterprise Architect, Archi, Lucidchart ou similares)

• Modelagem arquitetural baseada em ArchiMate (camadas de Negócio, Aplicação e Tecnologia)

• Definição de arquiteturas monolíticas, microsserviços e orientadas a eventos

• Integração de sistemas via APIs REST, mensageria e middlewares

• Experiência com múltiplas linguagens e stacks tecnológicas

(ex.: Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, Frontend Web)

• Arquitetura em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)

• Atuação colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento, produto, infraestrutura e negócios.


Idioma: Inglês técnico intermediário a avançado para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica, arquitetura de sistemas e interação com fornecedores e parceiros.


Certificações:

Desejável certificações relacionadas à Arquitetura de Software e Arquitetura Corporativa, tais como:

  • TOGAF (Foundation ou Certified)
  • ArchiMate
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • Azure Solutions Architect
  • Google Cloud Architect


Formação:

Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura de Software,

Arquitetura Corporativa ou Engenharia de Software.


Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Human Resources Junior Analyst
description:
Empresa de Consumo Massivo | Brasil


Consultoria especializada em recrutamento está conduzindo uma busca confidencial para uma empresa de consumo massivo com operação no Brasil.


Buscamos um(a) HR Junior Analyst para atuar de forma operacional no dia a dia de RH, colaborando com a execução de processos de Departamento Pessoal & Facilities e apoiando diferentes frentes da área, sempre em proximidade com as lideranças e o negócio.


A posição requer trabalho presencial em São Paulo, três vezes por semana.


Sobre o papel

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa organizada, proativa e com atenção aos detalhes para atuar de forma integrada nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal e Facilities , apoiando a jornada do colaborador e garantindo a eficiência dos processos administrativos e operacionais do escritório.


Principais atividades

  • Conduzir os processos de admissão, desligamento, férias e afastamentos, realizando lançamentos em sistema, geração de documentos e envio para assinatura digital.
  • Solicitar e lançar benefícios como vale-transporte, vale-refeição, auxílio home office, auxílio creche, mobilidade e benefício de aniversário, garantindo a correta execução desses processos.
  • Apoiar o onboarding de novos colaboradores, incluindo organização de coffee de boas-vindas, materiais e acompanhamento no primeiro dia.
  • Apoiar iniciativas relacionadas a clima e engajamento, incluindo organização de pesquisas internas e ações de melhoria, assim como apoiar na comunicação interna.
  • Organizar e apoiar ações internas voltadas à experiência dos colaboradores.
  • Administrar a infraestrutura do escritório, realizando compras de suprimentos, controle de estoque e acompanhamento de manutenções necessárias.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e serviços terceirizados.
  • Controlar acessos, estacionamento e credenciais, mantendo bases e planilhas atualizadas.
  • Dar suporte aos processos de Recrutamento e Seleção, acompanhando vagas, agendas e comunicações com candidatos.
  • Contribuir para a implementação e atualização de políticas e processos de RH, em alinhamento com diretrizes regionais.


Perfil buscado

  • Experiência prévia de 1 a 2 anos em áreas de RH, People Operations, Payroll, Facilities.
  • Bom domínio de Excel e facilidade para lidar com dados e controles.
  • Inglês e espanhol em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Perfil organizado, com boa capacidade de acompanhamento de múltiplas demandas.
  • Interesse genuíno por Recursos Humanos e desenvolvimento profissional na área.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e em constante evolução.


Candidaturas

Interessados(as) devem se candidatar diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Todas as aplicações serão tratadas com total confidencialidade.

title: Japanese Business Developer
description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are developing a partner advertising high-load system with a large RPS, convenient and modern interface. We are growing exponentially and successfully implementing new technologies to accelerate this growth and the system as a whole.

Now we look for a Japanese Business Developer to join our Growth Traffic team


Job Responsibilities

Research and Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough market research on Asian markets to identify opportunities for business expansion.
  • Perform competitive research to stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and potential market gaps.

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective affiliates, tracking outreach progress and follow-ups.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  • Regularly report on progress, including research insights, outreach results, and onboarding statuses.
  • Collaborate closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to align affiliate strategies and achieve team goals.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese language is a must
  • Fluency in English
  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.
  • Strong Network: Ability to leverage an existing network of contacts to expedite outreach and sales
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-Starter: Capable of working autonomously in a remote environment, with the motivation to consistently drive results.


Qualification that can be a plus:

  • Proven track of overachieving KPIs in Business Development or Sales positions.


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.
  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.
  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.
  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.
  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

title: Relacionamento Digital e Conversão de Pacientes
description:
Vaga: Comercial 1 – Relacionamento Digital e Conversão de Pacientes


Modelo: Híbrido (presencial e remoto)


Horário: Período da manhã e tarde


Contrato: MEI


Sobre a função:

Estamos em busca de uma profissional com perfil comercial, comunicativa e organizada para atuar no relacionamento digital com pacientes de uma clínica médica de alto padrão em São Paulo.

Essa função é estratégica. A profissional será responsável por transformar contatos digitais em consultas, consultas em procedimentos e manter o relacionamento ativo com a base de pacientes.


Principais responsabilidades:

• Atendimento ativo e receptivo via WhatsApp e redes sociais

• Conversão de leads em agendamentos de consulta

• Explicação de procedimentos para pacientes em potencial

• Confirmação de consultas e organização da agenda

• Recall de pacientes e oportunidades

• Envio de mensagens em datas comemorativas e campanhas

• Aplicação de NPS e acompanhamento da experiência do paciente

• Mensagens de pré check-in e pós procedimento

• Gestão e qualificação de leads no CRM

• Organização de cadastros e informações de pacientes


Perfil desejado:

• Perfil comercial e habilidade com vendas

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita

• Facilidade com WhatsApp, redes sociais e ferramentas digitais

• Organização e atenção aos detalhes

• Afinidade com o público feminino

• Proatividade e responsabilidade com metas


Imprescindível:

• Morar na Grande São Paulo

• Boa comunicação oral e escrita


Remuneração:

R$ 2.000,00 fixo + premiações por desempenho + transporte quando necessário

  • Essa profissional participa diretamente do crescimento e faturamento da clínica.


*Experiência prévia em clínicas médicas, estética, dermatologia, odontologia ou cirurgias será um diferencial.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Jr. Full-Stack Engineer (2+ yrs of experience) – 100% Remote | Contract | English Fluency | Brazil Based


We’re partnering with a global digital platform company that operates one of the world’s largest online ecosystems for communities, conversations, and user-generated content. Their mission is to empower people to connect around shared interests and cultural moments, enabling authentic discussion and high-impact digital experiences at massive scale.


They are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to lead the creation of in-app community experiences inside the social media ecosystem, with a strong focus on high-engagement cultural moments in the UK .


What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the conceptualization, design, and execution of in-app community experiences tailored to high-interest UK cultural moments
  • Build and launch robust, scalable client-side features using the Devvit Developer Platform
  • Translate cultural trends and community needs into high-performance web applications within Reddit, owning the full development lifecycle from idea to deployment
  • Develop a deep understanding of community culture and technical needs to rapidly iterate on content, features, and engagement strategies
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to turn growth strategies and community feedback into clear technical requirements
  • Analyze application performance and usage data to guide prioritization and iteration


Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript , HTML , and CSS
  • Demonstrable experience with React and modern front-end development
  • Experience building and deploying server-side applications using Node.js (Express, Koa, or similar frameworks)
  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and client/server architecture
  • Experience managing application state and data using tools such as Redis for caching or storage
  • Familiarity with the Devvit Developer Platform and its SDKs (@devvit/client, @devvit/server) is a strong plus


General Requirements

  • Fluent English , with a strong understanding of UK culture and language nuances
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and community launch cycles simultaneously
  • Experience designing and executing community activations or platform-based experiences
  • Strong familiarity with Reddit , its ecosystem, and user expectations
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different content verticals and cultural contexts
  • Availability to dedicate 20–40 hours per week to Reddit growth initiatives


Why this role

  • High ownership from concept to live community impact
  • Flexible remote contract
  • Opportunity to shape large-scale community experiences during high-traffic cultural moments

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.
